clips.title: The story
paras: Shen'dralas is a rugged, contested wilderness situated between Feralas, Mulgore, and south-eastern Desolace. Dominated by ancient night elven remnants and troubled borders, it serves as a volatile crossroads where encroaching centaur, displaced outcasts, and bristling quilboar collide.

Tucked away in the heights south-east of Desolace and bordered by Mulgore and Feralas, Shen'dralas is a raw borderland far removed from major faction capitols. Its craggy passes and hidden enclaves harbor desperate groups carving out existence on the edge of wild Kalimdor. From secluded vantage points like Evenshade Overlook to lawless refuges like Outcast Hideaway, the zone is defined by those who wish to watch unseen or stay forgotten.

The land bears the distinct mark of the highborne legacy that gave it its name, yet it is far from peaceful. Centaur conflict bleeds across the Magram Front, keeping old blood feuds alive and well along its borders. Meanwhile, encroaching quilboar maintain fortified redoubts such as Bristleback Retreat, turning every shadowed ravine into contested territory for any traveler passing through.

Leading out north-west toward Desolace lies the Valley of Bones, a grim corridor that serves as the primary overland access route into Shen'dralas. Bleached by sun and wind, this passage stands as a harsh reminder of the violent struggles that constantly ripple through these crags.
